questions.prompt: Record ID is numeric but should never be summed. On the Data Source page you:
options: Click the data-type icon atop the column → String (it's an identifier, not a quantity)
questions.explain: Identifiers → **String** so Tableau never aggregates them. Same page: double-click name to rename; right-click → **Split** (auto-detects the hyphen); right-click → **Describe** for role/type/distinct values.

questions.prompt: A BLUE date pill vs a GREEN date pill on a shelf means:
options: Blue = discrete date PARTS (headers); green = continuous date axis
Blue = year only; green = month only
questions.explain: **Blue = discrete** (YEAR, QUARTER… as headers), **green = continuous** (a true time axis). Drill-down: click the **+ on the date pill** → next level appears; drag unwanted levels off.

questions.prompt: Bars must show each sub-category's share of total sales. After sorting descending, you:
options: Right-click SUM(Sales) → Quick Table Calculation → Percent of Total (+ show labels)
questions.explain: **Quick Table Calculation → Percent of Total** converts the displayed aggregation without touching the data. Sort via the pill's Sort… or the toolbar icon.

questions.prompt: A Sales-vs-Profit scatter shows ONE dot. To get one mark per ROW of data:
questions.explain: **Analysis → Aggregate Measures off** = de-aggregate. Then Category → Color (Marks) or → Columns for separate panels. Reading: high sales + negative profit = discount damage.

questions.prompt: Bars (Sales) with an overlaid line (Discount) on two y-axes requires:
options: Both measures on Rows → right-click the 2nd pill → Dual Axis → set per-measure mark types (Bar / Line)
questions.explain: **Dual Axis** merges the second measure onto an opposite axis; the Marks card grows per-measure tabs (SUM(Sales) → Bar, SUM(Discount) → Line). Bar-in-bar bonus: dual axis + both Bar + different Sizes + **Synchronize Axis**.

questions.prompt: The calculated field `SUM([Profit])/SUM([Sales])` shows as AGG(Margin) because:
options: The calculation is ALREADY aggregated — Tableau cannot re-aggregate it (no SUM-of-AGG)
questions.explain: Ratio-of-sums must be computed at aggregate level (sum first, divide after) — hence **AGG()**, and the pill's aggregation menu is locked. This beats a row-level Profit/Sales which would average ratios incorrectly.

questions.prompt: "Customers with total sales > 5000" as a reusable In/Out object, and "customers active in BOTH 2017 and 2018":
options: Create Set (Condition: Sum of Sales > 5000) · two sets + Create Combined Set → 'Shared members in both sets'
questions.explain: **Sets** are reusable membership objects: Condition tab (By field: Sales/Sum/>5000). Year-overlap: build a set per year, Ctrl-select both → **Combined Set → shared members** → filter + COUNTD(Customer Name). Lecture's answer: **605 customers**.

questions.prompt: Double-clicking the State field instantly builds a map because:
options: Tableau assigns a GEOGRAPHIC ROLE and auto-generates Latitude/Longitude on Rows/Columns
questions.explain: Geographic role → generated lat/long. Then **Profit → Color** (diverging palette; darkest = biggest loss), **Sales → Size**, drill State → City via the pill's +, and right-click Category → **Show Filter**.

questions.prompt: Hovering a trend line reveals ______; the shaded forecast band is ______:
options: The equation, R² and p-value · the prediction interval (default 95%)
The data source name · a heat map
questions.explain: Analytics pane → **Trend Line** (Linear/Log/Exp/Polynomial/Power); hover = equation + R² + p-value. **Forecast** drag-on → band = 95% prediction interval; horizon via Forecast Options → 'Exactly 6 months'.

questions.prompt: With two data sources on one sheet, blue check vs orange check means:
options: Blue = PRIMARY source; orange = SECONDARY, auto-linked on the common field (orange chain-link icon)
questions.explain: First-used source = **primary (blue)**; fields pulled from the other make it **secondary (orange)**, blended on the common field (e.g., Category). Data Interpreter cleans junk headers; Pivot turns Jan-15…Dec-18 columns into Date/Value rows.
